author: reek
body: The last three rows pinned a defect when this test was written: pos-enc-value handed cordic-sin an argument a thousand times too small, so the sine half of every positional encoding read zero. Both halves are fixed now, the scale here and the quadrant fold in Math/Cordic, and the rows carry the correct answers. sin 4 is the row that needed both: it is past the interval the rotation could reach, so the scale fix alone would have moved it from zero to another wrong number.
